description: This file defines a PHP class 'Config' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Config', responsible for managing configuration settings for the OrangeHRM application. It provides constants, static methods for retrieving and setting configuration parameters, and handles configuration initialization and access.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: A class that manages application configuration constants and provides static methods to access and modify configuration settings.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value by its name, with an optional default if not set.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a configuration key exists.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a configuration value for a given key.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds multiple configuration parameters at once.

methods.name: isInstalled
methods.description: Checks if the configuration is properly installed by verifying the presence of the config file.

methods.name: getConf
methods.description: Returns the Conf object, initializing it if necessary.
